about: Adjust Layout, adjust font size: InDesign 2025 20.5.5.119 (DOM adjustLayout with allowFontSizeAndLeadingAdjustment, imposeFontSizeRestriction off) against Folio adjustLayout{adjust_font_size} on the same IDML (artifacts/screens-text-20261023/tools/fontfit_e2e.py, 2026-11-13). Page 300x400, margins 30, frame 160x100 at 40,40, no inset, hyphenation off, auto leading. The cases fill ragged lines; Folio sizes are larger than InDesign on five of seven (see rules/layoutadj-c7.ko.md).
